title: Frequency comb generation in active optomechanical cavities
summary: We numerically investigate frequency-comb generation in an electrically pumped vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser coupled to two mechanical modes of a suspended mirror. Displacement-dependent cavity loss and radiation-pressure feedback couple the mechanical motion to the carrier and photon densities, producing harmonics and combination-frequency components in the photon-density spectrum. Mechanical quality factors primarily control the intensity of comb lines, whereas resonance frequencies determine their spectral distribution.
